items.title: Black and Gold Art Deco Frame
items.alt: Tall open frame with black and gold fan ornaments at all four corners.
items.description: Thin gold rules connect the stepped corner fans. The narrow rectangular opening suits a formal upright layout without covering its center.

items.title: Blue Engraved Oval with Medallion
items.alt: Fine blue looping lines form an oval border with a small empty medallion below.
items.description: Overlapping curves create a woven engraved appearance around the broad opening. A scalloped circular badge interrupts the lower edge.

items.title: Black Botanical Divider
items.alt: Black stems, grasses and seed heads rise from a straight horizontal baseline.
items.description: Long narrow leaves alternate with round and branching flower heads. Their different heights create a lively silhouette above the fine lower rule.

items.title: Ivory Lace Circle
items.alt: Ivory circular lace border with scalloped petal loops and pierced details.
items.description: Small dotted lines follow the inner ring. Repeated open loops form a delicate edge around the clear circular center.

items.title: Golden Leaf Scroll Corner
items.alt: Ornate golden corner with curling leaves, tapered tips and a small central rosette.
items.description: The two arms sweep outward at a right angle. Dark recesses and bright ridges give the leafy ornament a raised metallic appearance.

items.title: Rope Frame with Blue Anchor
items.alt: Cream rope forms a rectangular frame with knotted corners and a hanging blue anchor.
items.description: Twisted strands run along each side of the opening. The small anchor hangs from a loop at the middle of the lower rope.

items.title: Stitched Denim U Border
items.alt: Indigo denim seam forms a U-shaped border with amber stitching and copper-colored rivets.
items.description: Two parallel stitch rows follow the curved lower corners. A small folded fabric tab protrudes from one side of the open frame.

items.title: Folk Floral Heart Border
items.alt: Red and navy flowers with mustard leaves form an open heart border.
items.description: The floral branches meet at a small pointed cluster below. Tiny diamonds and curled leaves balance the upper lobes.

items.title: Paper Crane Arch
items.alt: Six folded-paper cranes follow a fine curved line to form an open arch.
items.description: Teal, rust and ivory birds alternate in size and wing position. Their angular folds create a light decorative arc.

items.title: Curled Paper Teardrop Border
items.alt: Burgundy, cream and copper paper curls form a teardrop-shaped open border.
items.description: Tight spirals alternate with elongated loops along the sides. A pointed folded loop closes the top while rounded curls gather below.

items.title: Copper Hexagon with Succulents and Crystal
items.alt: Thin copper hexagon frame holds succulents at one corner and a hanging crystal at another.
items.description: Small green rosettes and trailing round leaves cluster at the lower left. A clear pointed pendant hangs inside the upper-right edge.

items.title: Pearl and Blue Gem Oval
items.alt: Pearl-like beads and small blue stones form an oval with a blue teardrop pendant below.
items.description: Silver-colored settings separate the alternating beads. The larger drop hangs beneath a small jeweled connector at the base.

items.title: Golden Scroll Frame with Blank Shield
items.alt: Slim golden rectangular frame has curled corners and a small empty shield below.
items.description: The upper corners curl inward while leaf-like lower ornaments sweep toward the shield. Thin straight rules leave a broad clear opening.

items.title: Silver Scroll Cartouche
items.alt: Silver ornamental border has a shell crest, curled sides and sweeping lower tails.
items.description: Bright ridges and dark grooves emphasize the raised scroll shapes. The opening narrows toward the elaborate split base.

items.title: Bamboo Frame with Leaf Sprays
items.alt: Four bamboo stems form a square frame with green leaf sprays in opposite corners.
items.description: Visible joints break up the pale tan stems. The leaves extend both inward and outward at the upper left and lower right.

items.title: Terracotta Mosaic Arch Border
items.alt: Open rounded arch border made of orange mosaic tiles with blue geometric insets.
items.description: Pale grout lines divide the small warm-colored tiles. Blue diamonds and tiny squares interrupt the pattern around the tall opening.

items.title: Mid-Century Ring and Starburst Oval
items.alt: Thin teal and gold rings with small starbursts form a horizontal oval border.
items.description: Larger circles occupy the sides while smaller linked rings stretch across the top and bottom. Tapered black spokes add contrast among the gold accents.

items.title: Double-Line Speech Balloon
items.alt: Black double-line oval speech balloon with a pointed lower-left tail.
items.description: The two slightly uneven contours follow the oval and its small tail. The empty opening leaves space for a short message.

items.title: Perforated Stamp Frame with Fern
items.alt: Tall cream stamp-shaped border with perforated edges, a green inner rule and a tiny fern.
items.description: Small regular notches follow the outer rectangle. A paired fern detail sits just inside the top edge above the empty center.

items.title: Burgundy Folded Ribbon Divider
items.alt: Long burgundy ribbon has stitched cream edges, layered ends and small brass-colored fasteners.
items.description: The broad center remains blank between the folded side loops. Pointed swallowtail ends extend from both sides.

items.title: Cream Flower Crescent
items.alt: Large cream flowers and dark green leaves follow a sweeping crescent branch.
items.description: Smaller buds extend toward the two tips. The broad blossoms cluster along the lower left while glossy leaves fill the gaps.

items.title: Fern and Seed-Head Vertical Border
items.alt: Fine fern fronds and small brown seed heads follow a narrow upright stem.
items.description: The sprigs alternate from side to side with uneven spacing. Delicate leaflets create a light vertical accent rather than a filled panel.

items.title: Grapevine Window Border
items.alt: A rectangular grapevine frame with green leaves and two purple grape clusters.
items.description: Twisting brown vines and curled tendrils connect the corners. The grape clusters sit diagonally opposite one another, leaving an open center.

items.title: Purple and White Orchid Cascade
items.alt: Purple and white orchid flowers cascade down a slender stem with pointed green leaves.
items.description: Small unopened buds extend above and below the blossoms. The loose vertical arrangement keeps each flower's shape distinct.

items.title: Seashell and Blue Pendant Garland
items.alt: Cream shells, sand dollars, blue pendants and a pink conch hang from a curved cord.
items.description: The larger pink shell drops beneath the middle of the line. Different shell shapes alternate along the gently sagging natural-colored cord.

items.title: Coral and Seahorse Circle
items.alt: Peach coral and pale blue sea fans form a circular border with a small seahorse.
items.description: The seahorse curls beside the lower-right arc. Fine branching fans alternate with thicker coral shapes around the clear center.

items.title: Butterfly Vine Corner
items.alt: Three different butterflies perch around a curved green vine corner.
items.description: Spotted orange, pale blue and cream wings appear at different angles. Small leaves follow the vine's long lower curl.

items.title: Black Feather Crescent
items.alt: Layered black-and-white feathers curve into an open crescent with a tied lower tip.
items.description: Fine lines trace the feather barbs along the sweeping outer edge. Dark quills overlap where the feathers gather below.

items.title: Blue Gingham Bow Divider
items.alt: Blue-and-white checked ribbon stretches from a large bow with two small folded loops.
items.description: The left bow has long pointed tails beneath its gathered center. The checked pattern follows the ribbon's small folds along the horizontal strip.

items.title: Purple Knitted Circle with Needles
items.alt: Thick purple knitted ring sits above crossed wooden needles and a small yarn ball.
items.description: Raised cable-like stitches follow the circle. A loose yarn end curls beside the ball beneath the needle crossing.

items.title: Pencil and Ruler Classroom Corner
items.alt: Yellow pencil, wooden rulers, pink eraser and curled shavings form a classroom corner.
items.description: The upright pencil stands beside a slanted ruler, with another ruler extending across the base. The eraser and shavings gather at their meeting point.

items.title: Colorful Crayon Zigzag Frame
items.alt: A red, blue, green and yellow zigzag crayon frame with two crayons below.
items.description: Short colored strokes fill the gaps between the zigzags. A red crayon and a blue crayon meet near the lower center of the open frame.

items.title: ABC Blocks and Toy Train Divider
items.alt: Colorful A, B and C blocks line up with a small toy engine and a red star.
items.description: The blocks tilt at different angles along the low horizontal arrangement. Round toy wheels and a red knob add small raised shapes between the letters.

items.title: Geometry Tools Triangle
items.alt: Blue set square, wooden rulers and a silver compass form a triangular arrangement.
items.description: The compass hinge closes the top point while the rulers follow the lower and right sides. The blue set square creates a smaller open triangle inside.

items.title: Paintbrush and Watercolor Side Border
items.alt: Three paintbrushes, colored swatches and a small watercolor box form a narrow side border.
items.description: The brush tips rise above blue, yellow and green paint marks. A leafy sprig and open paint pans finish the lower end.

items.title: Blue and Green DNA Border
items.alt: Stylized blue and green double helix forms a tall border with small molecular nodes.
items.description: The two winding strands connect through short rungs. Small round nodes extend from the sides at different heights.

items.title: Violin, Piano Keys and Treble Clef
items.alt: Orange violin, short piano keyboard and black treble clef line up in a horizontal arrangement.
items.description: Five black keys in two groups sit above eight white keys. The violin's warm wood contrasts with the neutral keyboard and curved music symbol.

items.title: Robot Circuit Corner
items.alt: Small blue robot peeks over an L-shaped border of navy circuit traces and gold contacts.
items.description: Parallel traces turn around the lower-left corner and end in round gold pads. The robot's bright eyes and single antenna give the small ornament a friendly focus.

items.title: Open Books and Bookmark Crescent
items.alt: Three open books, a small gold-colored lamp and a red ribbon form a curved side border.
items.description: Blank cream pages face the open center at different angles. The ribbon curls away below the lowest book.

items.title: Fox and Squirrel Branch Frame
items.alt: Thin twisting branches frame a seated fox and a squirrel on the opposite upper corner.
items.description: Small green leaves break up the woody border. The two animals face toward the open center from different heights.

items.title: Soccer Ball and Goal Net Corner
items.alt: Black-and-white soccer ball rests in grass beside a diagonal section of white goal net.
items.description: The tied net lines rise toward the upper right. Several pointed grass blades surround the lower part of the ball.

items.title: Basketball and Hoop Oval
items.alt: Thin orange oval lines connect an orange basketball and a small hoop with a white net.
items.description: The ball overlaps the left edge while the hoop sits above the right curve. The wide central opening remains clear.

items.title: Graduation Laurel Border
items.alt: Dark green laurel branches surround a black graduation cap, diploma and navy bow.
items.description: The two leafy branches rise around a broad opening. A gold tassel hangs from the cap above the rolled cream diploma.

items.title: Interlocked Gold Rings Divider
items.alt: Two interlocked gold rings sit between leafy sprigs and ivory ribbon curls.
items.description: The slim branches extend outward from the ring pair. Small pale ribbon folds soften the ends of the compact wedding ornament.

items.title: Blue Dreidel and Gold Coin Corner
items.alt: Blue dreidel, pouch of gold coins and curling navy ribbon form a festive corner.
items.description: Loose coins spill beside the small blue pouch. Fine gold edges follow the ribbon as it twists above and across the still life.

items.title: Holly and Bell Arch
items.alt: Sparse holly leaves and red berries form an arch topped with two brass-colored bells and a red bow.
items.description: The bells hang beneath the large bow at the top. Small leaf clusters and berries follow the two open sides.

items.title: Basket between Tall Cornstalks
items.alt: Two tall dry cornstalks rise beside a small woven basket.
items.description: Long curled leaves wrap around the golden stalks. Their outward lean creates a narrow U-shaped harvest border above the basket.

items.title: Spiderweb Scroll Corner
items.alt: Black-and-white spiderweb fills an ornamental corner above a small hanging spider.
items.description: Curved flourishes extend from the web's two outer arms. The little spider hangs near the inner lower curl.

items.title: Birthday Pennant Garland
items.alt: Colored patterned pennants hang between two paper honeycomb decorations.
items.description: Stripes, dots and solid colors alternate along the gently sagging cord. Yellow and blue folded-paper ornaments finish the two ends.

items.title: Black Geometric Maze Frame
items.alt: Bold black meandering lines form a square frame with enlarged corner turns.
items.description: A narrow double rule follows the inner opening. Repeated right-angle paths create a structured border around the clear center.
